forWhat: Who teaches which class and subject, and whole counts that can be checked. A person's pages open on the classes and subjects they hold. There is no score and no ranking: the school decides what the numbers mean.

layout.shows: Name, Role, Class, Sessions done of planned, Notes confirmed, Notes late and Lines accepted / changed / removed, grouped by role. Press a name to open what that person holds.
A button under the table. It opens a form for name, school email and role.
Every class and subject the person holds or held: the role, the class, the subject, from and to, and who gave it. With [[Add a grant]] and, on a grant that is still open, [[End a grant]].

jobs.title: Add a member of staff
steps: Type their name, school email and role. Press [[Add and send a link]].
They get an email with a link to set their password. It works once and lasts {t:password_link.first_days} days.
Then open their name and give them their classes.

jobs.title: Give a person a class or a subject
steps: Press the person's name, then press [[Add a grant]].
Choose the role and the class. A role held for a subject also asks for the subject. Press [[Save the grant]].

It starts today. Sometimes the school's rules say no, for example a second class educator for one class. The page says so in words. Type why it should stand anyway and press [[Save the grant]] again, or change what you chose.

jobs.title: Stop a person holding a class
steps: Press the person's name, find the grant, and press [[End a grant]].
It ends today. The grant stays on the list with its dates, marked Ended, and nothing is deleted.

buttons.label: Add and send a link
buttons.does: Adds the person and emails them a link to set their password.
buttons.doesNot: Nobody types a password for them.

buttons.label: Save the grant
buttons.does: Gives the person the role on the class, from today.
buttons.doesNot: It does not change anyone else's classes, and it cannot give a role that reaches beyond a class.

buttons.label: End a grant
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete the grant: it stays on the list, marked Ended.
